messages:
kiran: quick question — should the rerank response include a distinct 'penalty' field for per-candidate manual downgrades, or do we encode that as a negative 'raw_score'? thinking about how quotas & routing should treat these (tenant carve-outs, internal heuristics).
leah: product POV: prefer separate field. console wants to show 'original vs adjusted' so users can debug why a candidate dropped. also need a metric for % candidates penalized.
mike: eng-platform: separate field makes sense for visibility. important: billing needs a deterministic rule — penalties shouldn't change billable token units unless the model was called. we need a mandatory "score_units" in the envelope.
jamie: runtime: +1 for separate field. we can short-circuit applying simple heuristic penalties on the router side (no model call) which would reduce regen and cost. that implies a carveout flag at the request level so router can decide.
kiran: sketch of suggested contract (proto-ish):
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"cand_1","raw_score":0.81,"penalty":-0.20,"final_score":0.61,"score_units":3,"model_affinity":"r1-large"},
    {"id":"cand_2","raw_score":0.79,"penalty":0.00,"final_score":0.79,"score_units":3,"model_affinity":"r1-small"}
  ],
  "request_metadata": {"tenant_id":"acct_42","carveout":"dedicated", "canary":true}
}
```
leah: console needs to show columns: raw_score | penalty | final_score | model_affinity | billable_units. also allow filtering where penalty != 0 and a link to the rule that applied it.
mike: operational constraints: add explicit boolean "billable_model_call" per-candidate or per-request so billing pipeline can ignore local heuristics. otherwise invoices get messy.
jamie: routing: propose policy names: `carveout:d edicated` / `carveout:fallback` / `carveout:local` — router picks model based on that and model_affinity hints. if penalty applied locally, set billable_model_call=false.
kiran: telemetry we should emit: `penalty_applied` (tags: rule_id, tenant, magnitude), `penalty_rate` per-tenant, and `penalty_skipped_model_call` counter. console should graph those and surface alerts when penalty_rate > 5% for an account.
leah: UX question: should we surface penalty rollouts as a canary toggle in console? customers might be surprised. prefer an opt-in preview mode + audit log entry when we change penalties.
mike: rollout plan: v1 contract (separate penalty field + score_units + billable_model_call) -> SDKs pinned to v1 -> 2-week canary for internal tenants -> public opt-in. add server-side validation to reject ambiguous envelopes.
jamie: implementation note: keep penalty as additive scalar (not multiplicative) to avoid weird rank inversions at extremes. also document expected ranges (-1.0 to 0.0).
kiran: action items: 1) eng-platform to PR contract + schema validation (mike) 2) runtime to implement short-circuit + billable flag (jamie) 3) product to spec console columns + canary UX (leah) 4) telemetry to add metrics/events (kiran).
deploy-bot: canary deploy for rerank-contract/v1.0 started (canary group: internal-qa) :rocket:
leah: SGTM. I'll draft the console wire with the audit link.
mike: I'll add the validation layer and the billing mapping.
jamie: will prototype router short-circuit tomorrow and add tests for cache bypass.
kiran: thanks — syncing this to a tiny RFC doc. leaving thread open for any objections.
